tour.overview:
Nusa Penida, a rugged limestone island south-east of Bali, was until recently almost unknown to visitors. Its cliffs plunge more than 100 metres into the Indian Ocean, framing coves of white sand and turquoise water, and its waters are home to manta rays and, from July to October, the giant sunfish called mola mola. The island's roads are narrow and steep, which makes a private driver essential.

This private day takes you from your hotel to Sanur for the fast boat, about 45 minutes, and then around the west of the island with your own driver and guide. You see the famous viewpoints of Kelingking, Broken Beach and Angel's Billabong, have lunch with a sea view, and swim at Crystal Bay before the boat back.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 11 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in south Bali
• Type: private transfers, fast boat, private car and guide on Nusa Penida
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate; the island roads are bumpy, and the Kelingking path to the beach is very steep (optional)

WHAT YOU SEE
• Kelingking Beach.
• Broken Beach.
• Angel's Billabong.
• Crystal Bay.

WHY THIS WORKS
We take an early boat and visit the viewpoints in an order that avoids the main rush of day-trippers, with time for a proper swim at the end.

WHO IT SUITS
Couples, photographers and active families.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
If you dislike boats or bumpy roads, choose our Ubud or North Bali tours. Divers can book a manta ray dive instead.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The boat crossing can be rough, especially from July to September; take seasickness tablets if needed. The climb down to Kelingking Beach is dangerous in wet weather; most visitors enjoy the view from the top.

days.name: Fast boat to Nusa Penida, Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong, lunch and Crystal Bay
days.description:
What to expect: the cliffs and coves of Nusa Penida with a fast boat, private driver and guide, entrance fees, snorkelling gear and lunch.

Your driver collects you at your hotel at about 6:30 and takes you to Sanur beach for the 7:30 fast boat. The crossing of the Badung Strait takes about 45 minutes, with views back to Mount Agung on clear mornings. On the beach at Nusa Penida, your island driver and guide are waiting with the car.

You drive across the island on narrow roads through villages and dry farmland to Kelingking Beach. From the clifftop you see the famous headland shaped like a T-Rex, with a hidden white beach below lapped by turquoise waves. A steep, rough path leads down to the beach, about 40 minutes each way, for those who are fit and the conditions allow; most visitors enjoy the view from the top.

On the island's west coast you visit Broken Beach, Pasih Uug, a circular cove where the sea enters through a natural arch in the cliff, and walk along the clifftop to Angel's Billabong, a natural infinity pool in the rocks at the ocean's edge, safe to approach only at low tide and when the sea is calm. Lunch is at a restaurant with a view of the sea. In the afternoon you relax at Crystal Bay, a palm-fringed beach with clear water, where you can swim and snorkel among fish and corals near the shore. You take the afternoon boat back to Sanur, and your driver takes you to your hotel, arriving at about 18:00.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
06:30 – Pick-up at your hotel.
07:30 – Fast boat from Sanur.
08:30 – Meet your island driver and guide.
09:30 – Kelingking Beach.
11:00 – Broken Beach and Angel's Billabong.
12:30 – Lunch with a sea view.
14:00 – Crystal Bay, swimming and snorkelling.
16:00 – Fast boat back to Sanur.
18:00 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Angel's Billabong is dangerous at high tide or in big swells; your guide decides whether it is safe to go down.
• Snorkelling with manta rays at Manta Point can be added by boat.
• East Nusa Penida (Diamond Beach, the treehouse viewpoint) can replace the west on request.

INCLUDED: hotel transfers, return fast boat, private car and guide on the island, taxes and entrance fees, snorkelling gear, lunch, bottled water.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks with lunch, manta snorkelling, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Is the boat private?
faq.answer: The fast boat is a shared public service; once on the island, your car, driver and guide are private.

faq.question: Is the crossing rough?
faq.answer: It can be, especially from July to September. Sit at the back and take seasickness tablets if you are prone to it.

faq.question: Do we have to climb down to Kelingking Beach?
faq.answer: No. The path is very steep and only for fit walkers in dry conditions. The view from the top is the highlight.

faq.question: Are the fees included?
faq.answer: Yes: the boat, the island tax, site entrance fees and snorkelling gear.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, with a sea view. Vegetarian and other diets are easy to arrange.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes, for children who travel well by boat and car. The roads are bumpy; child seats are available.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. The main viewpoints are near the parking areas, but the paths are uneven and boarding the boat is from the beach.

faq.question: Can we see manta rays?
faq.answer: Yes, with an added snorkelling boat trip to Manta Point, depending on sea conditions.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tips are appreciated in Bali but never required.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Swimwear, quick-dry clothes, sandals or water shoes for the boat, trainers for the viewpoints, a hat and sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: April to October is dry and sunny, with mola mola from July to October. The sea is calmest from April to June.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before the tour, and at no cost if boats are cancelled for weather. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
